name: create_hello_world
description: Simplest possible test: creates hello.py that prints Hello, World!
prompts: Create a Python file called hello.py that prints 'Hello, World!'

test_setup_files.test_hello.py:
import subprocess, sys
out = subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, 'hello.py'], text=True)
assert 'Hello, World!' in out, f'expected "Hello, World!" in stdout, got {out!r}'
print('PASS')
